about: Generated by scripts/completion-census.py; read by scripts/completion-check.py. readers: package directory -> test -> index into sets. A set names the repository paths outside the package directory that the test read or stat'ed (`D/*` is every tracked file directly in D, `D/*.E` every one with that extension) and the directories it listed or stat'ed (`D/**` is D and every directory under it).
